summary: Similarweb Ltd. filed a 6-K and press release on May 13, 2026, announcing the initiation of a CEO succession planning process. Founder and CEO Or Offer intends to transition out of the role by mid-2027 after 20 years, working with the Board for a seamless handover. The Board is engaging a leading executive search firm; no exact terms, price, premium, or advisor specific to a transaction are disclosed. No change to strategy or financial outlook. Watch for updates on the search and timeline to identify the next CEO.
